classes.C: Mission configuration recorded in case.json (limits, gains, vehicle constants). Added to the requested classes because configuration is neither truth nor estimate.
classes.D-host: Derived by the recording host and stored in the run (verifier verdicts, host metrics, the interpolated contact sample).
classes.D-view: Derived by this view's extractor from recorded values. Arithmetic is named in the derivation registry; nothing is simulated.
classes.E: Estimate, recorded: what the controller's estimator reported, as stored in the trace.
classes.K: Controller command, recorded: what the controller decided and sent (throttle, gimbal), as stored in the trace under command. Kept apart from truth, observation and estimate.
classes.O: Observation, recorded: what a sensor delivered to the controller, as stored in the trace.
classes.S: From source code, not recorded in the run: read in the Rust sources at the stated lines.
classes.T: Truth, recorded: the simulator's true state, as stored in the trace.

altimeter_minus_truth_nozzle.formula: altimeter - truth nozzle-plane z (base_position_m[2]). Both refer to the nozzle plane.

altimeter_residual.formula: altimeter - estimated nozzle altitude, from the recorded post-update estimate at the sample. Approximate: the controller's own residual (S_rejection_rule) is evaluated every 0.02 s on a pre-update estimate with an unrecorded s_cm; the recorded estimate already includes the update of that cycle.

angular_rate_times_lever.formula: R4 angular rate (the host's norm of the true angular velocity) times s_cm at the touchdown sample (lever arm from centre of mass to nozzle plane). For a rotating body the nozzle velocity differs from the centre-of-mass velocity by about this much.

before.formula: True when the first value is smaller than the second.

believed_nozzle_xy.formula: estimated centre-of-mass x,y + horizontal part of rotate(IMU attitude, (-s_cm,0,0)). The nozzle-plane point guidance steers (S_nozzle_from_cm). Uses the s_cm proxy.

believed_pad_distance.formula: hypot(believed nozzle x - pad x, believed nozzle y - pad y), pad from case.json.

body_axis_z_from_imu.formula: z component of the body x axis rotated by the IMU attitude quaternion [w,x,y,z]: 2*(x*z - w*y).

cited_sources_identical.formula: True when every vv-rocket source cited as a source fact has the same per-file sha256 as the recording tree.

control_period.formula: control_period_steps * dt_s: how often the controller runs.

count_where.formula: Number of samples of the named series satisfying params.where (not null, null, true, or equal to a word).

equals_check.formula: True when the two recorded or derived values are equal.

est_minus_truth.formula: estimate_k - truth_k, both centre of mass, same axis k.

est_nozzle_altitude.formula: estimated centre-of-mass z - s_cm * body_axis_z (nozzle-plane altitude believed by the estimator). Uses the s_cm proxy.

evidence_file_line.formula: The first line starting with params.line_starts_with in the committed evidence file params.file, written by running the test named by the source fact.

fault_active_at_last_sample.formula: True when the configured fault kind is in the recorded active_faults of the last sample.

first_fix_jump.formula: gnss_position_gain * bias magnitude: the step in the estimate caused by one GNSS fix that carries the bias, when the estimate had been at the truth.

first_inside_radius.formula: t_s of the first recorded sample whose distance is at most the R5 radius.

first_over_threshold.formula: t_s of the first recorded sample whose absolute altimeter residual (approximate, see altimeter_residual) exceeds the rejection threshold. The controller's own first over-threshold cycle lies within a recorded sample interval of this.

first_sample_above.formula: t_s of the first recorded sample whose absolute value of the series exceeds params.threshold. A recorded sample, never an interpolated crossing. Null when no sample exceeds it.

first_sample_where.formula: t_s of the first recorded sample whose series value satisfies params.where (engine on, or command above zero). A recorded sample, not an instant between samples.

flags_identical.formula: True when the two recorded flag series are equal at every sample.

guidance_rule_from_flag.formula: 'min(estimator, altimeter)' while the recorded altimeter_rejected flag is true, 'estimator' otherwise (S_guidance_min, guarded policy). Says which rule was active, not which value won.

horizontal_speed_at_touchdown.formula: hypot of the two horizontal velocity components of the named series at the touchdown sample (host-interpolated truth).

inside_radius_at_touchdown.formula: True when the series value at the touchdown sample is at most the R5 radius.

inside_radius_runs.formula: Number of separate stretches of consecutive samples at most the R5 radius.

last_inside_radius.formula: t_s of the last recorded sample whose distance is at most the R5 radius.

lower_altitude_source.formula: While the rule is active: 'altimeter' if altimeter < estimated nozzle altitude, else 'estimator'. The altitude the min() of S_guidance_min would pick. Approximate (same limits as altimeter_residual); null while the rule is inactive.

max_abs_before_fault.formula: Largest absolute value of the named series over the samples before the fault start.

max_offset_check.formula: Largest |(truth cm z - truth nozzle z) - s_cm*n_z| over the samples, using the truth attitude. A check of the proxy geometry, not a measure of the controller's s_cm.

min_over_samples.formula: Smallest recorded value of the series.

none_true.formula: True when the recorded flag series is false at every sample.

nozzle_reference_check.formula: True when the requirement's recorded value equals the nozzle-plane quantity in verification.json touchdown.truth (R1: |base vz|; R2: horizontal base speed; R5: base position distance to the pad).

null_only_at_touchdown.formula: True when the only null GNSS sample is the off-grid touchdown sample.

obs_minus_truth.formula: gnss_k - truth_k: GNSS position is a centre-of-mass observation, same axis k.

pinned_recording_commit.formula: Pinned in extract.py. The test proves with git that the tree at this commit reproduces run.json source_sha256. It says the tree reproduces the hash, not that it built the run.

product_check.formula: True when params.factor times the first scalar equals the second to the stated tolerance (R6 limit = margin fraction times initial propellant).

s_cm_proxy.formula: s_cm = (dry_mass*dry_cm_station + propellant*propellant_cm_station) / (dry_mass + propellant), with the recorded TRUTH propellant as a proxy for the controller's unrecorded nominal propellant.

s_cm_station_bound.formula: s_cm with full propellant and with empty tanks, from case.json vehicle constants.

source_tree_diff.formula: Hashed sources whose per-file sha256 differs between the pinned recording tree and the working tree.

source_tree_sha256.formula: sha256 over the 20 vv-rocket hashed sources of the working tree, by the algorithm of crates/vv-rocket/src/lib.rs source_sha256 (CRLF read as LF).

touchdown_gap.formula: hypot(true nozzle x - believed nozzle x, true nozzle y - believed nozzle y) at the touchdown sample. The believed point is the last estimate before contact, approximate.

touchdown_sample_value.formula: Value of the named series at the touchdown sample (the last sample), unchanged.

velocity_difference_at_touchdown.formula: hypot(base_vx - truth_vx, base_vy - truth_vy) at the touchdown sample: nozzle-plane velocity minus centre-of-mass velocity.

S_altimeter_nozzle.claim: The altimeter measures the height of the nozzle plane (base z), not of the centre of mass.

S_cadence.claim: The controller runs once every control period (a fixed number of steps) and observes the altimeter and the IMU each time. GNSS is delivered only on every configured n-th control cycle. The trace stores a sample every record_every steps.

S_cause_active_faults.claim: The cause field of a requirement result is the list of faults active at the contact step. It is filled in whether the requirement passed or failed, so it is not an attribution.

S_detection_same.claim: For the guarded policy the sensor_disagreement flag is the altimeter_rejected condition: the two flags are one detection reported twice.

S_earlier_build_test.claim: The test stores this run's fixture, asserts that the strict replay is rejected at the canonical-request check (the stored request predates later parameters), and that the earlier-build replay is verified with its agreement check passing.

S_estimator_fixed_gain.claim: The estimator is a fixed-gain blend of IMU propagation, GNSS and a gated altimeter. It holds a position and a velocity and no covariance, so it has no uncertainty to report. The estimated position is the centre of mass.

S_gnss_bias.claim: The gnss_bias fault adds its magnitude to the GNSS position x and z (not y). GNSS position observes the centre of mass. GNSS velocity carries no bias.

S_gnss_ungated.claim: Every GNSS fix is blended into the estimated position with a fixed gain. Nothing compares GNSS x or y with another sensor, and nothing can reject it; only the altimeter is gated, in z.

S_guidance_min.claim: With the guarded policy, while the altimeter is rejected, guidance (only guidance; the estimator state is untouched) reads the lower of the estimated nozzle-plane altitude and the altimeter. A cycle without an altimeter sample uses the estimator's altitude. Which of the two was lower in a given cycle is not recorded.

S_ignition_rule.claim: While coasting, the controller lights the engine when it is descending faster than the target contact speed and the deceleration it needs (from the estimated nozzle altitude and velocity) reaches the ignition fraction of the available thrust-to-mass.

anchors: pub fn interpolate(a: &State, b: &State, u: f64) -> State {
S_interpolate.claim: Interpolation of the contact is linear in every component of the true state.

S_invariant_limits.claim: S1 is a lower bound (cosine of tilt at least the limit); S2 to S5 are upper bounds. S2 is evaluated at the contact only. Invariants keep a worst value and a first failure (null when none), not a time series.

anchors: let current = cycle.as_ref().ok_or("no control cycle at step 0")?;
S_last_cycle_in_sample.claim: The estimate and the observation stored in a sample are those of the latest control cycle, which can be a step or more older than the sample's own step.

S_nozzle_from_cm.claim: Guidance converts the estimated centre-of-mass position to the nozzle plane with the attitude and s_cm, and steers that nozzle-plane point (horizontal offset to the pad, altitude).

S_outcome_rule.claim: Outcome rule: no contact gives no_contact; contact with every requirement passing and S5 holding gives landed; every other contact gives hard_landing. The label therefore says that some requirement or S5 failed, not that the impact was hard.

S_rejection_not_fused.claim: In every control cycle whose residual exceeds the threshold, the altimeter is not fused into the estimate. This starts before the flag: the flag is raised on the configured number of consecutive such cycles. A residual within the threshold clears the counter and the flag and fuses the altimeter again. The only test of the altimeter is the residual against the estimate: the logic cannot tell which of the two is wrong.

S_rejection_rule.claim: The altimeter residual is the altimeter minus the estimated nozzle-plane altitude (estimated centre-of-mass z minus s_cm times the body-axis z component). The altimeter is rejected after the configured number of consecutive control cycles with a residual above the threshold. s_cm comes from the controller's own nominal propellant, which is not recorded.

anchors: /// Recomputes a stored run from its request and compares every file byte for byte.
pub fn replay_earlier_build<H: DomainHost>(host: &H, dir: &Path) -> ReplayReport {
S_replay_host_sdk.claim: The strict replay requires the stored request to be canonical under the current catalogue and then compares every recomputed file byte for byte. A run stored by an earlier build is rejected there when the current catalogue adds parameters. The earlier-build replay completes the request with the current defaults, re-simulates, and compares outcome, safety, requirement verdicts, telemetry channels, events and metrics; texts, the scene and the native files are not compared.

S_requirements_nozzle.claim: R1 and R2 are evaluated on the nozzle-plane velocity at contact and R5 on the nozzle-plane horizontal position against the pad.

anchors: let t_touch = ((step - 1) as f64 + u) * dt;
S_touchdown_sample.claim: The touchdown sample is off the sampling grid. Its truth is the contact state interpolated by the host between two steps; its estimate and observation are those of the latest control cycle, not interpolated.
